Proportional-to-series allocation was costed and rejected: it buys 1,499 series in total, puts 66.8 percent of them in one stratum and leaves 15 of 21 strata under 30 series, so most of the frame would return no reportable rate. claim: The registered minimum of n = 384 is carried from PRE-05 unchanged, and what it buys is computed rather than asserted.
value: n = 384 gives a 95 percent Wilson half-width of 2.21 points at the PRE-05 threshold p = 0.05 and 4.98 points at the least favourable p = 0.50; the smallest n reaching 5 points at p = 0.50 is 381 by Wilson and 385 by the conventional Wald formula

notes: Strata of 30 to 383 report a rate with a Wilson interval and a below-registered-n flag. Under 30 reports counts only and never a rate.

claim: The stratification absorbs the C3-12 provenance clustering completely, so the intracluster correlation for the conformance outcome has to be planned from a different measurement.
value: the C3-12 encoder flag has exactly zero within-stratum variance in all 21 strata; across the 15 stratum by proxy pairs of attribute-presence defects that do vary, the collection-level rho runs 0.508 to 1.000 with a median of 0.919
dropped: stratum by proxy pairs with no within-stratum variation return no rho and are excluded from the median, which is 21 of 36
status_note: The proxies are index-observable attribute-presence indicators, not conformance outcomes, and are labelled as proxies throughout. The reported intervals will use rho estimated from the realised sample, not this planning value.
notes: The measured median is used for sizing only. At that value the effective sample size of the frame is bounded by its stratum by collection cells rather than by its series, which is C3-12 arriving as a design consequence.
